# Database & API Requirements Checklist: Core Entry Workflow (SPEC-0006)

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the quality, clarity, and completeness of the SPEC-0006 requirements — data model migration, stored procedures/functions, and the Entries Web API layer. Validates the requirements writing, not the implementation.

**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | **Plan**: [plan.md](../plan.md) | **Data model**: [data-model.md](../data-model.md) | **API contract**: [contracts/entries-api.md](../contracts/entries-api.md)
